title: 第527章 重瞳开天与剑斩苍穹第526章 北疆惊变与造化青莲
slug: 全球没功法的我自创功法
content_zh:
林道心神沉入灰蒙空间，只见那尊神魔之魂正顶天立地，撑开这方混沌天地。
十二品造化青莲悬浮于侧，青色莲叶摇曳，绽放万千霞光，引动磅礴的混沌潮汐。
这朵伴生青莲，被山海强行以一滴造化本源重铸，以至宝之身夺天地造化，直接化作了先天灵器。
先天灵器，非人力所能打造而成，乃是天生地养的先天之器。
林道之所以能拥有这件极品先天灵器，完全是混沌女帝与山海这两尊恐怖存在的馈赠——以祂们自身本源为根基，赋予了他这份逆天机缘。
莲叶之上，烙印着浑然天成的金色脉络，玄妙莫测，那便是先天禁制。
十二品造化青莲之上，拥有整整四十九道先天禁制流转不息！
唯有先天灵器，才配拥有先天禁制。禁制的数量，直接决定了灵器的等阶：
四十九道为极品，三十六道为上品，二十四道为中品，十二道为下品。
这些信息并非神圣面具查询所得，而是被林道眼中的重瞳清晰解析而出。
自从黄金之瞳与血色荒芜之地，那道竖瞳意志，在山海的帮助下彻底融合。
觉醒了独属于自身的重瞳后，他的视野便已截然不同。
或许是融入了血色荒芜之地意志的缘故，这双新生的重瞳，具备了探查万物信息的本能，与神圣面具的全知侦测有着异曲同工之妙。
新生的十二品造化青莲衍生出了两种新特性：【造化神光】与【造化献祭】。
造化神光属于极致的反伤神技，可吸收万千攻击伤害，汇聚成更恐怖的造化神光进行反击；
而造化献祭的上限极高，可祭炼万物汇聚造化源光，制造出后天灵器乃至先天灵器。
但想要汇聚造化源光，这祭炼万物的消耗绝对是个无底洞。
林道估计，哪怕将如今蓝星上的所有资源进行献祭，也未必能点化出几件先天灵器来，除非遇到资源极为丰富的星球与世界。
林道眼中重瞳浮现，一红一金两颗眼瞳，在眼眶中飞速旋转，属于重瞳的玄奥信息涌入识海。
【弑天霸瞳】

*解析之眼：天生具备看透世间万物、解析万物、探查万物之能。
*霸道重界：消耗重瞳本源，目之所及之处，便是霸道场域笼罩之范围。（注：霸道场域可自成视界，具备困敌、意志压制、削弱境界的效果。）
*弑天破灭：消耗重瞳本源，可于双眼之中射出两道弑灭神光。（注：弑灭神光可无视目标任何防御，直接造成真实伤害。其真实伤害数值，等同于重瞳之主当前最强战力。）
林道深吸一口气，心中震撼不已。
这双弑天霸瞳比黄金之瞳强横了不止一点半点，简直恐怖如斯，但消耗也极为恐怖，直接燃烧重瞳本源。
如今仅凭他现在的境界，这双重瞳估计用不了几下，双眼就会出现短暂的失明。
紧接着，林道拿出了《斩天拔剑术》这门剑道神通，以及那块沉甸甸的星辰本源铁。
他先伸手翻看《斩天拔剑术》，仔细观摩起来。
《斩天拔剑术》，乃剑宗某位狂徒所创。
因妻子渡天劫而亡，那狂徒怨恨上天不公，日夜苦修钻研数百载，终自创这门斩天剑法。
斩天拔剑术共分三式：
*蓄剑式：按照特定修炼方式，可将自身剑意进行无限叠加。（注：剑鞘、剑器品质越好，所叠加剑意越盛，无上限。）
*拔剑式：拔剑速度越快，剑术威力越恐怖。（注：需全力普通拔剑十万次，拔剑术可小成；需全力普通拔剑百万次，拔剑术可大成。）
content_en:
Lin Dao's mind sank into the gray space, and he saw that the soul of the god and demon was standing upright, holding up the chaotic world.
The twelfth-grade green lotus of good fortune is suspended on the side, the green lotus leaves are swaying, blooming with thousands of rays of light, triggering the majestic tide of chaos.
This companion green lotus was forcibly recast by the mountains and seas with a drop of the origin of creation. It took over the creation of heaven and earth in the body of the supreme treasure and directly turned it into an innate spiritual weapon.
Innate spiritual weapons cannot be made by human beings, but are innate weapons nurtured by nature.
The reason why Lin Dao was able to possess this top-quality innate spiritual weapon was entirely a gift from the two terrifying beings, the Empress of Chaos and Shan Hai - based on their own origins, they gave him this heaven-defying opportunity.
On the lotus leaves, there is a golden vein imprinted on it, which is mysterious and unpredictable. It is the innate restriction.
On top of the twelfth-grade creation Qinglian, there are a total of forty-nine innate restrictions that circulate endlessly!
Only innate spiritual weapons are worthy of possessing innate restrictions. The number of restrictions directly determines the level of the spiritual weapon:
Forty-nine paths are the best, thirty-six are the top grade, twenty-four are the middle grade, and twelve are the low grade.
This information was not obtained by querying the sacred mask, but was clearly analyzed by the double pupils in Lin Dao's eyes.
Since the golden pupil and the bloody wasteland, the will of the vertical pupil has been completely integrated with the help of the mountains and seas.
After awakening his unique double pupil, his vision was completely different.
Perhaps due to the integration of the will of the bloody wasteland, these new double eyes have the instinct to detect information about all things, which is similar to the omniscient detection of the sacred mask.
The reborn twelfth-grade Creation Green Lotus has derived two new characteristics: [Creation Divine Light] and [Creation Sacrifice].
Divine Light of Creation is the ultimate anti-injury skill. It can absorb thousands of attack damage and converge into even more terrifying Divine Light of Creation for counterattack;
The upper limit of creation sacrifice is extremely high, and all things can be sacrificed to gather the source light of creation to create acquired spiritual weapons and even innate spiritual weapons.
But if you want to gather the source light of creation, the consumption of this sacrifice to refine all things is absolutely a bottomless pit.
Lin Dao estimated that even if all the resources on the current Blue Star were sacrificed, a few innate spiritual weapons might not be able to be enlightened, unless they encountered planets and worlds with extremely rich resources.
Double pupils appeared in Lin Dao's eyes. Two pupils, one red and one gold, rotated rapidly in the eye sockets, and the mysterious information belonging to the double pupils poured into the sea of ​​consciousness.
【Slaying Heavenly Tyrant Eyes】
*Analytical Eye: Born with the ability to see through, analyze, and explore all things in the world.
*Hegemonic Realm: Consume the source of heavy pupil, and wherever you look, it is the scope covered by the domineering field. (Note: The domineering field can form its own horizon, which has the effects of trapping enemies, suppressing will, and weakening the realm.)
*Destroy the Sky: Consume the source of double pupils to shoot two rays of divine annihilation light in both eyes. (Note: Killing Divine Light can ignore any defense of the target and directly cause real damage. Its real damage value is equivalent to the current strongest combat power of the Lord of Double Eyes.)
Lindao took a deep breath, feeling shocked.
These sky-killing eyes are more than a little bit more powerful than the golden eyes. They are simply terrifying, but the consumption is also extremely terrifying, directly burning the source of the heavy eyes.
Now, based on his current state, it is estimated that these double pupils will cause temporary blindness in both eyes within a few seconds.
Immediately afterwards, Lin Dao took out the magical swordsmanship "Sword Cutting Technique" and the heavy piece of star origin iron.
He first reached out to read "The Art of Cutting the Sky and Drawing the Sword" and observed it carefully.
"The Art of Cutting the Sky and Drawing the Sword" was created by a madman from the Sword Sect.
Because his wife died during the heavenly tribulation, the madman resented the injustice of God. He practiced hard day and night for hundreds of years, and finally created his own sky-cutting sword technique.
There are three types of sword-cutting techniques:
*Sword Storage Style: According to a specific practice method, one's own sword intent can be superimposed infinitely. (Note: The better the quality of the scabbard and sword, the stronger the superimposed sword intent will be. There is no upper limit.)
*Sword Drawing Style: The faster you draw the sword, the more powerful your swordsmanship will be.The more powerful it is, the more terrifying it is. (Note: You need to use all your strength to draw a sword 100,000 times, and you can achieve minor success in sword-drawing skills; you need to use all your strength to draw a sword a million times, and you can achieve great success in sword-drawing skills.)
